policy:0.en: Grey Crow slid a cracked data-chip across the steel table. 'Every signal tower in Harbor City runs on this *policy*,' he said, voice flat. The document inside was short — three rules that decided who could speak and who stayed silent. I read it twice. My hands went cold.
policy:0.cnHint: 灰鸦把一份管控信号塔的____文件推到我面前，我越读越心寒。
policy:0.hook: The third rule had my name on it.
policy:0.line: Grey Crow: 'This *policy* decides whose voice survives tonight.'

industry:0.en: The old port district was Harbor City's rusted spine. Ali pointed at the dark towers rising from the waterfront. 'The signal *industry* owns every broadcast channel below Deck Nine,' she said. 'Legal on paper. A cage in practice.' I stared at the towers and finally understood why no one here ever spoke above a whisper.
industry:0.cnHint: 阿栗指着港口的信号____巨头，告诉我那里才是真正的沉默制造者。
industry:0.hook: One of those towers just went dark.
industry:0.line: Ali: 'The signal *industry* here does not sell sound — it buries it.'

concern:0.en: Zero leaned against the doorframe, arms crossed. My report on the missing broadcast nodes sat open on the desk between us. 'Your *concern* is touching,' he said, each word sharp as broken glass, 'but those nodes did not disappear. They were moved.' He smiled once, then left. The door locked itself behind him.
concern:0.cnHint: 零点对我关于节点失踪的____不屑一顾，却留下了一个更可怕的答案。
concern:0.hook: Moved — but to where, and by whose order?
concern:0.line: Zero: 'Your *concern* is real, but your map is wrong.'

present:0.en: Ali set a small metal box on the counter without a word. 'Consider it a *present*,' she said, almost too quietly. Inside, coiled like a sleeping wire, was a signal tracer I had looked for across six districts. It could find Zero's hidden channel. It could also get us both arrested. I closed the box slowly.
present:0.cnHint: 阿栗送给我一件危险的____，它能追踪零点的隐秘信号。
present:0.hook: Accepting it meant there was no turning back.
present:0.line: Ali: 'Take it — think of it as a *present* from someone who still trusts you.'

claim:0.en: A coded broadcast cut through the static at midnight. A voice, flat and altered, began to *claim* full control over Harbor City's eastern grid — all seventeen towers, all channels, all at once. Grey Crow looked up from his screen. 'That is Zero,' he said. I asked how he was sure. He said nothing.
claim:0.cnHint: 一个神秘声音在午夜广播中____对东区电网的完全控制权。
claim:0.hook: Grey Crow's silence was louder than any alarm.
claim:0.line: Zero: 'I *claim* this grid — and no signal moves without my word.'

half:0.en: The power cut hit without warning. *Half* the monitors in the room went black at once, and the hum of the building dropped to a low, uneasy moan. Ali grabbed the backup drive. Grey Crow checked the door. In the sudden dark I could see a thin line of red light beneath the far wall — a hidden panel, now unlocked.
half:0.cnHint: 突然断电，室内____的屏幕熄灭，黑暗中一个隐藏的暗格悄然开启。
half:0.hook: Behind that panel, something was already moving.
half:0.line: Ali: '*Half* the grid is gone — someone cut it from inside this building.'

successful:0.en: Grey Crow read the log entry aloud: a *successful* connection to the city's core language filter, made at 03:00 from this very room. He set the screen down and looked at me. I had been in this room at 03:00. So had he. Neither of us had touched that terminal. We both knew what that meant.
successful:0.cnHint: 日志显示有人在这个房间____接入了城市核心语言过滤器，但我们谁都没有动过那台终端。
successful:0.hook: Someone else had been in the room with us.
successful:0.line: Grey Crow: 'A *successful* login at 03:00 — and neither of us did it.'

access:0.en: The locked archive room held every signal map Zero had ever filed. I found a side terminal and tried to *access* the oldest records — the ones from before Harbor City's broadcast laws changed. A prompt blinked once. Then a second voice, not the system, spoke through the speaker: 'I wondered when you would look there.'
access:0.cnHint: 我试图____零点档案室里最早的信号记录，却听到了一个不属于系统的声音。
access:0.hook: The voice knew exactly how long I had been searching.
access:0.line: Zero: 'You can *access* my old files — I left them open just for you.'

positive:0.en: The signal map on my desk glowed with fresh data. Grey Crow leaned over and tapped the screen. 'This trace is *positive*,' he said, voice steady. Every other lead had gone cold, but this one pointed straight at Zero's last known shelter. I grabbed my coat.
positive:0.cnHint: 灰鸦在信号地图上发现了一个____的线索，指向零点的藏身之处。
positive:0.hook: The address on the screen was my own building.
positive:0.line: 'This trace is *positive* — move now or lose him.'

economic:0.en: Zero's gang did not steal for fun. Ali spread the files across the floor. 'Every hit follows an *economic* pattern,' she said, circling three numbers in red. Warehouses, data vaults, transfer nodes — all tied to one supply chain. Someone was draining the city from the inside.
economic:0.cnHint: 阿栗发现零点团伙的袭击有明显的____规律，目标都与城市供给链有关。
economic:0.hook: The name at the top of the chain was one I recognized.
economic:0.line: 'Every move fits an *economic* pattern — this is no random theft.'

link:0.en: I found the burnt chip inside the wall vent, half-melted but readable. It was the *link* between Zero's street crew and someone high in the city grid. Without it, we had noise. With it, we had a chain. Ali looked at me. Neither of us spoke for a long moment.
link:0.cnHint: 我在通风口找到了一块芯片，它是零点与城市高层之间的____。
link:0.hook: Ali's hand was shaking as she held the scanner.
link:0.line: 'That chip is the *link* — break it and the whole chain falls.'

produce:0.en: Grey Crow sat alone under a single bulb, hands moving fast over a worn keyboard. 'I can *produce* a fake clearance code in ten minutes,' he said without looking up. Zero's people would never know it was bait. I watched the lines of text scroll and said nothing.
produce:0.cnHint: 灰鸦说他能____一个假通行码来诱捕零点的人。
produce:0.hook: Then the lights in the building cut out all at once.
produce:0.line: 'Give me ten minutes and I can *produce* a code they will trust.'

teach:0.en: 'Let me *teach* you how Zero hides a signal,' Grey Crow said, pulling up a waveform on the cracked wall screen. Each pulse looked like noise unless you knew the beat. He tapped a rhythm on the desk. I listened, and slowly the noise became words. Cold words.
teach:0.cnHint: 灰鸦要____我如何识别零点隐藏在噪声中的信号。
teach:0.hook: The words spelled out my name.
teach:0.line: 'I will *teach* you the beat — after that, silence speaks.'

worth:0.en: Ali dropped a small drive on the table. 'Everything Zero owns is on that thing,' she said. 'Is it *worth* the risk to read it here?' The safe house walls were thin. Any signal we pulled could be traced back in seconds. I picked up the drive anyway.
worth:0.cnHint: 阿栗问读取零点的数据是否____冒这个险。
worth:0.hook: A footstep landed on the stairs outside the door.
worth:0.line: 'Tell me — is it *worth* the risk, or do we run now?'

common:0.en: Zero and I had nothing in *common*, or so I had believed. Then Grey Crow showed me the old record — same district, same school block, same year. I stared at the photo on the yellowed page. The face next to mine was younger, but the eyes were the same cold grey.
common:0.cnHint: 灰鸦发现我和零点有一段____的过去，令我震惊。
common:0.hook: I had no memory of him, and that terrified me.
common:0.line: 'You two share more *common* ground than you want to admit.'

daily:0.en: Ali had been tracking Zero's courier for two weeks. She pinned her notes to the board: *daily* routes, rest stops, hand-off points, all colour-coded. 'He never changes the path,' she said. That kind of habit was a gift. And a trap — for him, or maybe for us.
daily:0.cnHint: 阿栗记录了零点信使的____行动轨迹，发现了规律。
daily:0.hook: Today the courier had stopped somewhere new.

determine:0.en: The server room hummed beneath Precinct Nine. I spread three stolen data chips across the cold floor. Grey Crow crouched beside me, eyes narrowed. 'We need to *determine* which chip holds Zero's real access code,' he said, 'before the night patrol reaches this corridor.'
determine:0.cnHint: 我们必须____出哪块芯片藏着零点的真实密码，时间不多了。
determine:0.hook: Footsteps echoed — the patrol was already one floor up.
determine:0.line: 'We need to *determine* which chip holds the real code.'

response:0.en: I sent a ping through the underground relay. The screen stayed dark for thirty seconds. Then Ali leaned over my shoulder and whispered, 'No *response* from Grey Crow's node — either the signal is jammed or he's already been caught inside the archive hall.'
response:0.cnHint: 我发出信号后，灰鸦毫无____，阿栗觉得情况不妙。
response:0.hook: A single red light blinked once, then died.
response:0.line: 'No *response* — either he's jammed or he's gone.'

search:0.en: Zero's drones began a slow *search* of every floor in the data tower, their blue beams sweeping left to right through the dark corridors. Ali pulled me behind a stack of old server racks and pressed one finger to her lips. We had maybe two minutes.
search:0.cnHint: 零点的无人机开始对大楼逐层____，我们躲在机架后屏住呼吸。
search:0.hook: The nearest beam stopped — right outside our hiding spot.
search:0.line: 'The *search* pattern is tightening — we move now.'

due:0.en: The lockdown alarm was *due* to trigger at midnight, sealing every exit in the building. Grey Crow had warned us twice. I checked the clock on Ali's wrist panel: eleven fifty-eight. Two minutes to reach the service door or we would be sealed inside until morning.
due:0.cnHint: 封锁警报____在午夜启动，我们只剩两分钟逃出大楼。
due:0.hook: The second hand swept forward, cold and indifferent.

regard:0.en: Grey Crow stood at the head of the dim table and *regarded* the cracked monitor in silence for a long moment. Then he turned to us. 'Zero did not break this screen by accident,' he said quietly. 'Treat every scratch in this room as a message.'
regard:0.cnHint: 灰鸦静静____着那块破损的屏幕，断定这不是意外。
regard:0.hook: Behind the monitor, a tiny camera lens winked in the dark.
regard:0.line: '*Regard* every scratch here as a deliberate message.'

true:0.en: Ali handed me a folded note she had peeled from under the desk. The handwriting matched Grey Crow's, but the words were strange. 'Is this *true*?' I asked. She shook her head slowly. 'Grey Crow never uses that code phrase. Someone copied his hand to feed us false directions.'
true:0.cnHint: 纸条上的内容是否____？阿栗认为有人在模仿灰鸦的笔迹误导我们。
true:0.hook: The real Grey Crow could be anywhere — or nowhere.
true:0.line: 'If this were *true*, Grey Crow would never use that phrase.'

depend:0.en: 'Whether we get out clean will *depend* on the next sixty seconds,' Ali said, fingers racing across the keypad. The door to the relay chamber was still locked. I watched the corridor behind us while she worked, every sound from the ventilation shaft feeling like a threat.
depend:0.cnHint: 能否安全脱身完全____于接下来六十秒阿栗的操作。
depend:0.hook: The keypad beeped — and displayed the wrong colour.
depend:0.line: 'Everything will *depend* on what you do in the next sixty seconds.'

expensive:0.en: Zero's private terminal sat in the centre of the room, sleek and silent. Grey Crow touched its edge and pulled his hand back fast. 'This is *expensive* — military grade, not black-market,' he said. 'Zero has a backer with real power. Change your plan. Now.'
expensive:0.cnHint: 零点的终端设备极为____，说明他背后有强大的金主，我们的计划必须改变。
expensive:0.hook: Somewhere above us, a heavy door unlocked itself.
expensive:0.line: 'This is *expensive* — military grade. Someone powerful is behind Zero.'

explain:0.en: Grey Crow spread a stolen data chip on the cold table. 'You have sixty seconds,' he said. I had to *explain* every symbol on that chip before Zero's signal reached our floor. Forty floors up, the elevator hummed. Time was not on my side.
explain:0.cnHint: 灰鸦要求我在时限内____芯片上的每个符号。
explain:0.hook: The elevator doors opened one floor too early.
explain:0.line: '*Explain* that last symbol, and do it fast.'

examine:0.en: Ali locked the door and handed me a cracked lens. 'Use this,' she whispered. I began to *examine* the coded graffiti scratched into the wall panel, each line hiding a frequency. Outside, rain hammered the window like a fist that wanted in.
examine:0.cnHint: 阿里让我用破损的镜片仔细____墙上的密码涂鸦。
examine:0.hook: One frequency matched Zero's last known broadcast.
examine:0.line: '*Examine* every scratch — one of them is a trap.'

influence:0.en: Zero's voice came through the static, smooth and certain. 'Words *influence* the weak,' he said. I traced the signal to a small speaker hidden inside a ceiling tile. Grey Crow had warned me about this room. Now I understood why he never entered it alone.
influence:0.cnHint: 零点的声音从静电中传来，声称语言能____弱者。
influence:0.hook: The speaker was still warm — someone had just left.

argue:0.en: Ali and I began to *argue* in low, tight voices beside the server rack. She said the exit code was blue; I said red. Every second we wasted, Zero's lock-out timer climbed. Grey Crow watched from the corner, arms folded, saying nothing, which was somehow worse.
argue:0.cnHint: 阿里和我在服务器旁小声____出口代码的颜色。
argue:0.hook: The timer hit zero before either of us moved.
argue:0.line: 'Don't *argue* — just pick a colour and commit.'

pass:0.en: Grey Crow slid a folded card under the table without looking at me. I had to *pass* it to Ali before the room scanner completed its sweep. My hand moved slow and flat across the cold surface. The scanner beeped once, paused, then continued its arc.
pass:0.cnHint: 灰鸦要我在扫描仪完成扫描前把卡片____给阿里。
pass:0.hook: Ali's fingers closed around the card — then went still.
pass:0.line: '*Pass* it now, while the scanner faces the wall.'

serious:0.en: Ali set down the decryption tool and looked at me. Her face was *serious* in a way I had not seen before, not even during the broadcast blackout. 'This code does not unlock a door,' she said quietly. 'It unlocks a person.' The hum of the city felt very far away.
serious:0.cnHint: 阿里放下解密工具，用____的表情告诉我这段代码的真正用途。
serious:0.hook: 'A person' — and I already knew which one.
serious:0.line: 'Be *serious*: this changes everything we thought we knew.'

despite:0.en: *Despite* the noise from the street thirty floors below, the room felt sealed, almost airless. Grey Crow had found a clean frequency at last. I watched the signal bloom on the screen, steady and bright, while Zero's jamming pattern pressed in from all sides like dark water.
despite:0.cnHint: ____楼下街道的嘈杂声，房间里却安静得令人窒息。
despite:0.hook: Then the clean frequency blinked once and died.
despite:0.line: '*Despite* the jam, the signal held — until now.'

express:0.en: I tried to *express* what I had heard in the signal, but the words felt wrong in my mouth, like borrowed clothes. Grey Crow leaned forward. 'Try again,' he said, 'slower.' Ali was already writing. Whatever I described next would go straight into the city's hidden broadcast grid.
express:0.cnHint: 我努力____从信号中听到的内容，灰鸦要求我放慢速度再说一遍。
express:0.hook: What I said next could wake the whole city up.
express:0.line: '*Express* it exactly as you heard it — every word.'

conduct:0.en: Grey Crow slid a cracked data-chip across the table. 'Your *conduct* inside the server room was sloppy,' he said, voice flat. 'Zero watched every move.' The safe-house hummed with low static. I stared at the chip, then at the door. Someone had followed me here.
conduct:0.cnHint: 灰鸦批评我在服务器室内的____，并警告零点已经盯上了我。
conduct:0.hook: The door handle turned — from the outside.
conduct:0.line: 'Your *conduct* in that room put us all at risk.'

reveal:0.en: Ali pulled back the torn wall panel. Behind it, a hidden screen flickered to life and began to *reveal* a map of every signal tower in Harbor City. Dozens of red dots blinked. I counted them twice. Zero had already planted code in each one. The city was a trap.
reveal:0.cnHint: 阿栗打开暗格，屏幕开始____出零点在全城布下的信号网络。
reveal:0.hook: One red dot was blinking right under our feet.
reveal:0.line: 'This screen will *reveal* everything Zero has been hiding.'

powerful:0.en: The broadcast jammer on the desk looked ordinary — grey box, two switches. Grey Crow said it was the most *powerful* device in Harbor City, able to silence every frequency at once. I reached for it. He caught my wrist. 'Not yet,' he said. 'Not until we know who is listening.'
powerful:0.cnHint: 灰鸦警告我，这台看似普通的设备是全城最____的信号干扰器。
powerful:0.hook: Static burst from every speaker in the room at once.
powerful:0.line: 'This small box is more *powerful* than any weapon Zero owns.'

push:0.en: Ali spread the floor plan across the table. 'Zero is planning a final *push* tonight,' she said, tracing a red line through the lower grid. 'Every exit sealed, every channel jammed.' The clock on the wall read 23:41. I felt the walls of the safe-house close in around me.
push:0.cnHint: 阿栗告诉我零点今晚将发动最后的____，封锁所有出口。
push:0.hook: The lights cut out at exactly 23:42.
push:0.line: 'We have one hour before Zero begins the *push*.'

wonder:0.en: I stood in the archive room and stared at rows of glass drives, each one tagged with a date going back fifty years. The sheer scale of it filled me with *wonder* — and dread. Someone had recorded everything: every word, every deal, every secret in Harbor City. Zero had built a memory palace.
wonder:0.cnHint: 我在档案室里被眼前的规模震惊，心中充满____，同时意识到零点掌握了一切秘密。
wonder:0.hook: My own name appeared on the very last drive.
wonder:0.line: 'Look at all this — do you feel the *wonder*, or just the fear?'

design:0.en: Grey Crow unrolled a circuit sheet under the lamp. 'Zero did not find this weakness by accident,' he said. 'They *designed* the whole network to fail at one point.' I traced the single thin line that connected every node. One cut. That was all it would take. One cut, and Harbor City goes dark.
design:0.cnHint: 灰鸦解释说零点早已____好了整个网络，让它在一处崩溃。
design:0.hook: The thin line on the sheet began to glow red.
design:0.line: 'They *designed* this failure into the network from the very beginning.'

exercise:0.en: 'You need to *exercise* more caution with every log you open,' Ali said, watching me scroll through Zero's files on the cracked terminal. 'Each file is a possible trap.' I slowed my hand. Three files were already open. A soft ping told me something had just been triggered. We had seconds.
exercise:0.cnHint: 阿栗提醒我浏览零点的文件时要____更多谨慎，但已经太迟了。
exercise:0.hook: A countdown appeared on the screen: three, two, one.
exercise:0.line: 'You must *exercise* caution — Zero baits every single file.'

space:0.en: The safe-house server room was smaller than a closet. Every centimetre of *space* was filled with stacked drives and humming cables. Ali and I stood back to back, barely able to breathe. Grey Crow worked fast at the lone terminal. Outside, Zero's patrol drones swept the alley with cold white light.
space:0.cnHint: 服务器室里几乎没有多余的____，我们三人挤在一起等待灰鸦完成操作。
space:0.hook: A drone beam slid under the door and stopped at our feet.
space:0.line: 'There is no *space* to hide anything — and nowhere left to run.'

real:0.en: The server room hummed beneath Harbor City's oldest library. Grey Crow pressed a cold chip into my hand. 'This data is *real*,' he said, 'not the fake feed Zero pumps through every screen in the city.' I stared at the chip. If it was true, everything I thought I knew was a lie.
real:0.cnHint: 灰鸦给了我一块芯片，声称它记录的是____的数据，而非城市中流传的虚假信息。
real:0.hook: The chip was already getting warm in my fingers.
real:0.line: 'This is *real* — don't let them convince you otherwise.'

talk:0.en: Ali pulled me into a supply closet between two humming server racks. 'We need *talk*,' she said, dropping her voice to a whisper. Outside, Zero's drones swept the corridor with pale blue light. She slid a folded note into my jacket pocket and pressed one finger to her lips.
talk:0.cnHint: 阿栗把我拉进储物间，说我们需要进行一次____，同时零点的无人机就在走廊外搜索。
talk:0.hook: The note in my pocket felt heavier than paper should.
talk:0.line: 'We need *talk* — right now, before they loop back.'

energy:0.en: The city grid flickered. Every light in the sub-basement lab died at once. Grey Crow did not move. 'Zero is draining *energy* from this block,' he said quietly, 'which means he already knows we are here.' In the sudden dark, the only glow came from a single blinking cursor on Ali's screen.
energy:0.cnHint: 灰鸦判断零点正在抽取该区域的____，这意味着我们的藏身处已经暴露。
energy:0.hook: Then even that blinking cursor went dark.
energy:0.line: 'He is draining *energy* from the whole block — move now.'

plan:0.en: Ali spread a hand-drawn map across the cold floor. Every exit was marked in red. 'This is the *plan*,' she said, tracing a thin line through the maintenance tunnels beneath the library. I counted four checkpoints. Grey Crow said nothing, but the look on his face told me at least one of those checkpoints was already compromised.
plan:0.cnHint: 阿栗展示了她的____，标出了所有出口，但灰鸦的表情暗示情况并不乐观。
plan:0.hook: Grey Crow circled one checkpoint, then capped the pen.
plan:0.line: 'The *plan* gets us out — if that tunnel is still clear.'

bear:0.en: The old archive room smelled of dust and burned wire. Rows of dead terminals lined the walls. 'I cannot *bear* this silence,' Ali said. She was right — a building this wired should never be this quiet. Grey Crow knelt by a floor panel, listening. Something below us was breathing in slow, mechanical pulses.
bear:0.cnHint: 阿栗说她无法____这种死寂，灰鸦则跪地倾听地板下方奇怪的机械声响。
bear:0.hook: The mechanical pulse below us suddenly doubled in speed.
bear:0.line: 'I cannot *bear* this quiet — something is very wrong here.'

organization:0.en: A single file on the recovered chip listed one name: VEIL. 'That is the *organization* behind the coded broadcasts,' Grey Crow said, his voice flat. I had heard the name only once before, scratched into the wall of an abandoned relay station. Ali looked at us both. 'If VEIL knows we have this chip, we have maybe one hour.'
organization:0.cnHint: 芯片上的文件揭示了一个名为VEIL的____，灰鸦表示它就是幕后黑手。
organization:0.hook: Somewhere above us, a door opened without a key.
organization:0.line: 'VEIL is an *organization* with reach far beyond this city.'

opportunity:0.en: Zero's signal cut through every speaker in the lab with a low, clean tone. Then his voice came: 'I am giving you one *opportunity* to walk away.' Ali's hand found my arm. Grey Crow did not blink. The tone faded. In the silence that followed, I understood that Zero never made offers — only traps.
opportunity:0.cnHint: 零点通过广播给了我们一次____，但灰鸦的反应让我意识到这不过是个陷阱。
opportunity:0.hook: Grey Crow whispered, 'Do not move. Not one step.'
opportunity:0.line: 'I am giving you one *opportunity* — choose fast.'

professor:0.en: The face on the cracked monitor was old, tired, and familiar. 'That is Dr. Solen,' Ali breathed. 'He was a *professor* at Harbor City Tech before VEIL made him disappear.' The man on screen was reading numbers aloud, over and over, into a dead mic. Grey Crow touched the screen gently, like he recognised a ghost.
professor:0.cnHint: 监视器上出现的男人曾是一位____，阿栗说他在被VEIL带走之前在海港城理工任教。
professor:0.hook: Dr. Solen stopped reading, looked straight at the camera, and smiled.
professor:0.line: 'He was a *professor* once — now he belongs to VEIL.'

career:0.en: The file on my desk was thin but sharp. Grey Crow dropped it without a word. 'This person had a long *career* in signal work,' he said, 'until someone erased every record of it.' I opened the cover. The photo inside had been cut out. Only a name remained.
career:0.cnHint: 档案里的某人整段____都被人为抹除了，我翻开封面，照片已不翼而飞。
career:0.hook: The name on the file was mine.
career:0.line: 'A *career* built on secrets always ends the same way.'

medium:0.en: Grey Crow pointed to the old radio unit bolted to the wall. 'This *medium* still carries signals the new networks block,' he said quietly. Ali pressed her ear close. Static. Then, beneath it, a voice counting down in steady pulses. We had maybe three minutes before the signal vanished forever.
medium:0.cnHint: 一台老旧的无线电作为特殊____，传来了倒计时的神秘声音。
medium:0.hook: The countdown reached two, then went silent.
medium:0.line: 'Every *medium* has a frequency they forgot to shut down.'

office:0.en: The door read CITY RECORDS in faded paint. Inside, the *office* smelled of dust and old paper. Rows of cabinets lined every wall. Ali found the drawer marked ZERO before I did. It was empty — but the lock had been forced open from the inside, not the outside.
office:0.cnHint: 我们闯入档案____，发现那个关键抽屉是从内部被撬开的。
office:0.hook: Something had escaped from that drawer, not broken in.
office:0.line: 'This *office* hid more than paper — and someone knew it.'

culture:0.en: The underground room was covered in coded graffiti. Grey Crow ran a finger along one wall. 'This is the *culture* of the old signal runners,' he said, 'a language only they used.' Ali photographed every mark. I noticed one symbol repeated exactly nine times. Nine was Zero's number.
culture:0.cnHint: 地下室的涂鸦文字属于信号跑者的独特____，其中一个符号反复出现。
culture:0.hook: Nine marks — and Zero had been here recently.
culture:0.line: 'You can read a city's *culture* in what it writes on walls.'

college:0.en: The map showed a building in the east grid: Harbor *College*, closed for fifteen years. Grey Crow said Zero had studied there before the signal wars. Ali pulled up a floor plan on her pad. One room had been crossed out in red pen by someone who knew the building well.
college:0.cnHint: 地图上，一所废弃的____被人用红笔划去了某个房间。
college:0.hook: That crossed-out room still had power running to it.
college:0.line: 'The *college* closed, but Zero never really left it.'

value:0.en: Ali cracked the encrypted folder at last. Inside were numbers — hundreds of them. 'The *value* of each entry matches a signal frequency,' she said, eyes wide. Grey Crow nodded slowly. Someone had been pricing forbidden broadcasts like market goods. And the highest-priced signal was the one we had just sent.
value:0.cnHint: 加密文件夹里，每条记录的____对应一个被禁的信号频率。
value:0.hook: Our own signal sat at the top of the list.
value:0.line: 'Know the *value* of a signal and you control who speaks.'

connection:0.en: The lights in the record room flickered once, then held. Grey Crow tapped the cable running along the floor. 'There is a *connection* between this building and the old relay tower,' he said. Ali checked the grid map. The relay tower had been officially demolished two years ago. Officially.
connection:0.cnHint: 灰鸦发现这栋楼与一座"已拆除"的中继塔之间存在____。
connection:0.hook: The cable was warm — current was still flowing.
connection:0.line: 'Cut the *connection* and we lose everything we came for.'

story:0.en: I found the journal wedged behind a loose wall panel. Each page held a short *story* — coded, but readable if you knew the key. The last entry stopped mid-sentence. Grey Crow read it over my shoulder and went very still. Ali asked what was wrong. He closed the journal without a word.
story:0.cnHint: 日记里的每个____都暗藏密码，而最后一篇在句子中途戛然而止。
story:0.hook: Grey Crow's hands were shaking for the first time.
story:0.line: 'Every *story* in here is a warning someone never finished sending.'

force:0.en: The server room hummed beneath Control Tower Nine. Grey Crow pressed a cold key into my hand. 'They will *force* the door in three minutes,' he said. I scanned the blinking terminals. Somewhere in this room, Zero had hidden a signal — one that could silence every voice in Harbor City.
force:0.cnHint: 灰鸦警告我，对手会用____打开那扇门。
force:0.hook: The lock clicked — but I had not touched it.
force:0.line: 'They will *force* the door before you find it.'

importance:0.en: Ali pulled me behind a stack of dead monitors. Static crackled on every screen. 'You still don't see the *importance* of that broadcast,' she whispered, eyes sharp. The timestamp on the hidden file read 00:00 — midnight, tonight. Whatever Zero had planned, it was set to begin in hours, not days.
importance:0.cnHint: 阿栗提醒我，那段广播的____远超我的想象。
importance:0.hook: The timestamp suddenly changed to 00:01 — counting down, not up.
importance:0.line: 'You still don't see the *importance* of what he buried here.'

sell:0.en: Grey Crow laid the evidence chip on the table between us. 'Every officer in this tower is for *sell*,' he said flatly, voice like gravel on glass. I stared at the chip. Names, ranks, prices — all encoded in light pulses. Zero had bought the whole floor before I even knew the game had started.
sell:0.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉我，这栋楼里的每个警员都在被____。
sell:0.hook: My own name glowed at the bottom of the list.
sell:0.line: 'Every badge in this tower is for *sell*, rookie.'

replace:0.en: The screen flickered and Grey Crow's face vanished. A stranger stared back from the camera feed — same coat, same seat, different eyes. Zero had found a way to *replace* the live image with a loop. I had been watching a ghost for twenty minutes while the real Grey Crow was somewhere else, alone.
replace:0.cnHint: 零点用假影像____了灰鸦的实时画面。
replace:0.hook: The real Grey Crow's tracker had gone completely dark.
replace:0.line: 'He *replaced* the feed — we've been watching nothing.'

approach:0.en: Ali spread a hand-drawn map across the cold floor. 'There is only one safe *approach* to the relay room,' she said, tracing a narrow corridor with her finger. Every other path was monitored, tagged, or wired. I memorised the route in seconds. Then the lights in the corridor went out, one by one.
approach:0.cnHint: 阿栗指出，通往中继室只有一条安全的____。
approach:0.hook: Something moved at the far end of the only safe path.
approach:0.line: 'This is the only *approach* Zero won't have covered — yet.'

engage:0.en: Grey Crow's voice came through the earpiece, low and steady. 'Do not *engage* Zero directly — he wants you to.' I froze at the doorway. Zero stood twenty steps away, back turned, waiting. It felt like a trap shaped like an invitation. I kept my hands still and listened to the hum of the machines.
engage:0.cnHint: 灰鸦警告我，不要主动____零点。
engage:0.hook: Zero turned slowly, and smiled as if he had heard every word.
engage:0.line: 'Don't *engage* him — that's exactly what he's been waiting for.'

ensure:0.en: Ali rerouted the power cable with steady hands. 'We must *ensure* the signal reaches the outer grid before midnight,' she said without looking up. One wrong wire and the whole room would go dark — and so would our only chance. Outside, rain hammered the tower walls like a broadcast no one could decode.
ensure:0.cnHint: 阿栗告诉我，我们必须____信号在午夜前到达外部网格。
ensure:0.hook: The cable sparked — and the countdown froze at 00:00.
ensure:0.line: 'We must *ensure* this reaches the grid — or it all ends here.'

limit:0.en: The encrypted file opened at last. Columns of names, zones, and numbers filled the screen. Grey Crow leaned close. 'Zero set a *limit* on how many voices can broadcast after midnight,' he said. Above a certain number, the system would erase them all. I counted the names. We were one over the line.
limit:0.cnHint: 灰鸦发现，零点对午夜后的广播数量设有____。
limit:0.hook: One name had to be removed — and Grey Crow was already deciding whose.
limit:0.line: 'He set a *limit* — and we are already past it.'

sign:0.en: The server room hummed beneath the old market. I swept my flashlight across the walls. Cables ran in strange patterns, and coded graffiti covered every surface. Then I saw it — a red *sign* above the exit door, shaped like a broken eye. Grey Crow had warned me about this symbol.
sign:0.cnHint: 我在服务器室的出口处发现了一个神秘的____，那是灰鸦曾警告过我的标志。
sign:0.hook: The broken eye was still blinking.
sign:0.line: 'That *sign* means Zero has already been here,' Grey Crow said.

feeling:0.en: Ali pressed her back against the cold wall of the relay station. The monitors were dark, but the air smelled of burnt wire. I could not explain it, yet a sharp *feeling* told me someone was still inside. I motioned to Ali to stay low and moved toward the far door alone.
feeling:0.cnHint: 在中继站里，我有一种强烈的____，觉得房间里并非只有我们两人。
feeling:0.hook: A shadow moved behind the last monitor.
feeling:0.line: 'Trust that *feeling* — it has kept us alive so far,' Ali whispered.

professional:0.en: The decryption kit on the desk was not cheap street gear. Every tool was clean, ordered, and purpose-built. Grey Crow crouched beside it and said nothing for a long moment. Whoever had set this up was no amateur. This looked like the work of a *professional* — someone with serious backing.
professional:0.cnHint: 我们在密室里发现的解密工具包，显然出自某位____之手。
professional:0.hook: Grey Crow's jaw tightened — he recognised the kit.
professional:0.line: 'Only a *professional* with government access could afford this,' Grey Crow said.

behind:0.en: The archive room had one light, yellow and weak. Rows of old data drives lined the shelves. I found the file I needed, but when I turned to leave, the door was shut. Ali was gone. A soft sound came from *behind* the last shelf — steady, deliberate, and growing closer.
behind:0.cnHint: 当我准备离开档案室时，才意识到有什么东西藏在书架____。
behind:0.hook: Whatever was there, it had been waiting for me.
behind:0.line: 'Do not look *behind* you — just walk to the exit,' Ali said through the earpiece.

government:0.en: The paper was stamped in three places and sealed with a code I had only seen in restricted files. Grey Crow spread it flat on the table under the single bulb. It was an internal order — not from any corp, not from the street. This came straight from the *government* district uptown.
government:0.cnHint: 灰鸦展开那份文件，发现它直接来自____机构，盖有最高级别的印章。
government:0.hook: The order had been signed just six hours ago.
government:0.line: 'If the *government* sent this, then Zero has powerful friends,' I said.

growth:0.en: Zero's data map filled the cracked screen from edge to edge. Ali traced the network lines with one finger. The web had doubled in the past month. 'Look at the *growth*,' she said quietly. What had started as a small rogue signal was now a system that reached under half the city's grid.
growth:0.cnHint: 阿里盯着屏幕上的数据地图，对网络规模的____感到震惊。
growth:0.hook: And it was still expanding, in real time.
growth:0.line: 'This *growth* means Zero is almost ready to move,' Ali said.

negative:0.en: I ran the signal scan twice. Both times the result came back clean. Grey Crow stood at the window, arms crossed, unconvinced. 'A *negative* reading here means nothing,' he said. 'Zero builds dead zones on purpose — places where our tools go blind.' He pulled the scanner from my hand and switched it off.
negative:0.cnHint: 扫描仪显示____结果，但灰鸦告诉我这正是零点精心设计的盲区。
negative:0.hook: He was right — the silence itself was the trap.
negative:0.line: 'A *negative* result in Zero's territory is a warning, not a relief,' Grey Crow said.

potential:0.en: The locked sub-level had never appeared on any map I had studied. Ali found the hatch under a false floor panel. Whatever was down there had power — the heat sensors showed active hardware. Grey Crow called it a *potential* command centre, but his voice carried more certainty than the word allowed.
potential:0.cnHint: 阿里发现了隐藏的地下舱口，灰鸦认为这里是____的指挥中心。
potential:0.hook: We had thirty seconds before the floor timer reset.
potential:0.line: 'This is a *potential* trap — but we go in anyway,' Grey Crow said.

perhaps:0.en: The signal room smelled of old wire and rain. Grey Crow spread a cracked map across the table. 'The breach came from inside,' he said quietly. '*Perhaps* the leak is someone we already trust.' I stared at the map. Every marked point led back to one building: ours.
perhaps:0.cnHint: 灰鸦盯着地图，暗示泄露者____就在我们内部。
perhaps:0.hook: The nearest marked point was my own desk.
perhaps:0.line: '*Perhaps* the enemy is already sitting beside us.'

video:0.en: Ali pulled up a *video* feed on the cracked monitor. The footage showed a hooded figure copying files in the archive room — timestamp: last night, 02:17. No one was supposed to be in that room. I leaned closer. The figure paused, looked up, and seemed to stare straight into the lens.
video:0.cnHint: 阿栗找到了一段____，画面里有人深夜在档案室复制文件。
video:0.hook: The hooded figure's badge number matched mine.
video:0.line: 'This *video* was wiped — someone put it back for us to find.'

prevent:0.en: I slammed the archive door and jammed a chair under the handle. Grey Crow had warned me: once Zero's script ran, no one could *prevent* the broadcast from going city-wide. I had four minutes. The terminal blinked, waiting. One wrong keystroke and Harbor City would hear everything.
prevent:0.cnHint: 我试图在最后关头____信号向全城扩散。
prevent:0.hook: The timer skipped ahead — someone was accelerating it remotely.
prevent:0.line: 'We have one shot to *prevent* the whole city from going dark.'

source:0.en: 'Find the *source*,' Grey Crow said, not looking up from the relay board. Every illegal broadcast in Harbor City traced back to a single origin node — ghost-tagged, invisible on the public grid. Ali had been hunting it for six weeks. Tonight her screen finally stopped scrolling and locked on one address.
source:0.cnHint: 阿栗终于追踪到了非法信号的____所在地。
source:0.hook: The address was inside the city's own police tower.
source:0.line: 'Cut the *source* and the whole network goes blind tonight.'

available:0.en: I needed a signal scrambler, fast. Ali checked the supply locker — empty. 'Only one unit still *available*,' she said, sliding a battered device across the table. It was held together with tape and hope. Grey Crow raised an eyebrow. I picked it up anyway. It was that or silence.
available:0.cnHint: 紧急关头，我们发现只有一台破旧的设备____可用。
available:0.hook: The device's power light flickered once, then died.
available:0.line: 'This is the only tool still *available* — make it work.'

customer:0.en: The front of the shop looked normal: a dim repair stall, a bored clerk, one *customer* waiting with a broken handset. But Ali had mapped the power draw. The back room pulled ten times the current it should. Grey Crow touched my arm. 'That customer hasn't moved in forty minutes,' he murmured.
customer:0.cnHint: 一家普通维修店里，一位____一动不动地等了四十分钟。
customer:0.hook: When I looked again, the customer's chair was empty.
customer:0.line: 'That *customer* is not here to fix a phone.'

language:0.en: The graffiti covered the whole east wall — bright, fast, layered. To anyone walking past it was art. To me it was a warning. Grey Crow had taught me to read this *language*: colour for danger level, symbol for location, a crown for Zero. Three crowns burned at the top of the wall.
language:0.cnHint: 灰鸦教我读懂墙上涂鸦的隐秘____，三个王冠让我背脊发凉。
language:0.line: 'Learn this *language* fast — the walls here speak before people do.'

test:0.en: 'This is a *test*,' Ali said, her voice flat. She pointed to the relay box: a single green wire, a single red wire, and a timer counting down. Cut the wrong one and the signal floods every screen in the district. Cut the right one and we learn who planted it. Grey Crow was already gone.
test:0.cnHint: 阿栗说这是一场____——剪错了线，信号将淹没整个街区。
test:0.hook: My hand hovered over the wire as the timer hit ten.
test:0.line: 'Every move Zero makes is a *test* — and we keep passing too slowly.'

save:0.en: The server room hummed under Grey Crow's feet. Ali pressed her back against the cold rack. 'Every copy is gone,' she whispered. I watched the progress bar crawl. One backup remained. I hit the key to *save* the last file before Zero's worm reached it.
save:0.cnHint: 在服务器机房，我们拼命____最后一份文件，蠕虫病毒正步步逼近。
save:0.hook: The bar froze at ninety-nine percent.
save:0.line: 'We have ten seconds to *save* this file — move!'

service:0.en: The elevator was dead. A hand-painted sign read: OUT OF *SERVICE* — USE STAIRS. Ali pointed at the wiring behind the panel. Someone had cut it on purpose. Grey Crow said nothing. He just tapped the wall twice, listening for a hollow space behind it.
service:0.cnHint: 电梯____中断，但铁灰鸦敲了敲墙壁，似乎发现了什么不寻常的地方。
service:0.hook: Behind the wall, something beeped once.
service:0.line: 'This *service* outage is not an accident, trust me.'

note:0.en: I found a folded paper on the keyboard. One word, handwritten: RUN. I almost missed the tiny *note* taped under the desk — a frequency, six digits. Ali read it aloud. Grey Crow went still. 'That frequency,' he said quietly, 'belongs to Zero.'
note:0.cnHint: 我在桌子底下发现一张隐藏的____，上面写着一个属于零点的频率。
note:0.hook: Grey Crow's hand moved to his earpiece.
note:0.line: 'This *note* under the desk — Zero left it for us.'

probably:0.en: The lights in the data lab flickered twice, then held. Ali ran a trace on the last login. 'Someone was here an hour ago,' she said. I checked the chair — still warm. Grey Crow studied the exit. 'Zero *probably* watched us walk in,' he said flatly.
probably:0.cnHint: 数据实验室里椅子还是温的，铁灰鸦认为零点____目睹了我们进入的全过程。
probably:0.hook: A camera lens in the corner tilted toward us.
probably:0.line: 'Zero *probably* knows every move we plan to make.'

strategy:0.en: Grey Crow spread three printed maps across the table. Each one showed a different entry point into the archive floor. Ali circled the air vent in red. 'Zero will block two of these,' Grey Crow said. 'Pick one wrong and it is over.' This was a *strategy* session, not a briefing.
strategy:0.cnHint: 铁灰鸦摆出三张地图，这场____讨论决定我们能否突破档案楼层。
strategy:0.hook: Ali's pen stopped over the one route Grey Crow had not mentioned.
strategy:0.line: 'Our *strategy* must look like a mistake to fool Zero.'

building:0.en: From the stairwell window I could see the whole block. Every light in the target *building* was off — every floor, every office, all at once. Ali checked her scanner. No heat signals. Grey Crow pulled me back from the glass. 'That darkness is a trap,' he said.
building:0.cnHint: 目标____突然全楼熄灯，铁灰鸦警告那片黑暗本身就是陷阱。
building:0.hook: Then one window on the top floor lit up red.
building:0.line: 'That *building* going dark means Zero is already inside.'

community:0.en: The local mesh network served the whole district. Grey Crow called it a *community* grid — forty blocks, thousands of nodes, all sharing signal. Zero had poisoned three of those nodes. Ali traced the spread on her screen. If we did nothing, the silence would reach every home by dawn.
community:0.cnHint: 零点污染了____共享网格的节点，寂静将在黎明前蔓延至每家每户。
community:0.hook: Ali's cursor landed on our own building's node.
community:0.line: 'The whole *community* grid will go dark before morning.'

internet:0.en: The room had no windows and one cable. Grey Crow plugged in and nodded. 'Still live,' he said. The *internet* connection here was the last clean line in the district — Zero had cut every other route. Ali locked the door. Whatever we sent through this wire, we had one chance to send it.
internet:0.cnHint: 这条线路是整个区唯一幸存的____接入口，我们只有一次机会发送信息。
internet:0.hook: A second later, someone on the outside began typing back.
internet:0.line: 'This *internet* line is the only one Zero has not touched.'

easily:0.en: The server room hummed beneath Grey Crow's safehouse. I spread the stolen maps across the cold floor. 'Zero can *easily* trace this signal back to us,' Grey Crow said, eyes fixed on the blinking terminal. 'We have maybe four minutes.' Ali was already pulling cables from the wall.
easily:0.cnHint: 灰鸦警告说，对手____能追踪到我们的信号，阿栗开始拔掉电缆。
easily:0.hook: The terminal blinked once — then went dark.
easily:0.line: 'Zero can *easily* trace this signal back to us.'

protect:0.en: Grey Crow locked the server room door and pressed his back against it. 'This drive holds every name,' he said. 'We must *protect* it at any cost.' Ali slid the small device into her jacket. Outside, footsteps echoed down the corridor — slow, deliberate, getting closer.
protect:0.cnHint: 灰鸦要求我们____那个存有所有名字的硬盘，走廊里传来脚步声。
protect:0.hook: The footsteps stopped right outside our door.
protect:0.line: 'We must *protect* this drive at any cost.'

advantage:0.en: Zero had arrived first. He stood at the centre of the control room, calm, surrounded by screens. 'You came,' he said. 'That is your only *advantage* — I did not expect it.' Grey Crow stepped forward. I noticed Zero's left hand was already moving toward the console.
advantage:0.cnHint: 零点承认我们提前赶到是唯一的____，但他的手已经悄悄移向控制台。
advantage:0.hook: Grey Crow's hand shot out and grabbed mine.
advantage:0.line: 'That is your only *advantage* — I did not expect it.'

break:0.en: We needed a *break* in the encrypted feed — just one gap where a clean signal could slip through. Ali hunched over the keyboard, sweat on her brow. 'Thirty seconds,' she whispered. The room felt smaller. Grey Crow stood at the window, watching the street below go quiet.
break:0.cnHint: 阿栗努力在加密信号中寻找____，灰鸦在窗边注视着街道。
break:0.hook: Then the feed went silent — too silent.
break:0.line: 'We need a *break* in the feed, just thirty seconds.'

conclude:0.en: I studied the scatter of data fragments across the screen until the pattern became clear. I could only *conclude* one thing: Zero had been inside our network for weeks. Grey Crow said nothing. Ali set down her cup. The silence in the safe room felt like a held breath.
conclude:0.cnHint: 研究数据碎片后，我只能____零点早已潜入我们的网络，房间里一片沉默。
conclude:0.hook: Someone knocked — three times, then once.
conclude:0.line: 'I can only *conclude* that Zero has been inside for weeks.'

figure:0.en: Grey Crow pulled up the latest intercept on the screen. 'Look at this *figure*,' he said, pointing to a single number buried in the code — 114. 'Every message Zero sends ends with it.' Ali leaned in. I wrote it down. Small numbers, I was learning, carry the heaviest weight.
figure:0.cnHint: 灰鸦指出每条信息末尾都有一个相同的____，我把它记了下来。
figure:0.hook: Ali whispered, 'I have seen that number before.'
figure:0.line: 'Look at this *figure* — it ends every single message.'

fit:0.en: Ali handed me a worn grey coat from the locker. 'Try it,' she said. It was a perfect *fit* — almost as if someone had made it for me. Grey Crow looked up from the console. 'That belonged to our last investigator,' he said quietly. No one said what happened to her.
fit:0.cnHint: 阿栗递给我一件外套，穿上去非常____，灰鸦轻声说那是上一位调查员留下的。
fit:0.hook: I did not ask what happened to her.
fit:0.line: 'That coat is a perfect *fit* — almost too perfect.'

particular:0.en: Zero left clues everywhere, but this *particular* message was different. It was addressed to me — my code name, no one else's. Grey Crow read it twice and handed it back without a word. Ali watched my face. 'He knows you,' she said. 'That is not good for any of us.'
particular:0.cnHint: 零点留下的这条____信息直接写着我的代号，灰鸦看完后一言不发。
particular:0.hook: My code name — who told him my code name?
particular:0.line: 'This *particular* message is addressed to you alone.'

stick:0.en: The server room smelled of burnt circuits. Grey Crow pressed a data chip against the cold wall panel. 'It won't *stick*,' he muttered. The adhesive was dead. Without the chip in place, Zero's signal would vanish in seconds. I held my breath and pressed harder.
stick:0.cnHint: 灰鸦试图将数据芯片____在墙板上，但时间快要耗尽。
stick:0.hook: The chip slid free — and the countdown hit zero.
stick:0.line: 'If it won't *stick*, we lose everything in ten seconds.'

effective:0.en: Ali spread three signal blockers across the desk. 'Only one of these is *effective* against Zero's encryption,' she said, eyes steady. The other two would burn out our gear. I stared at the blinking devices. Outside, rain hammered the window like a warning.
effective:0.cnHint: 阿里告诉我，三个信号干扰器中只有一个是____的。
effective:0.hook: She reached for one — but I caught her wrist just in time.
effective:0.line: 'Only this one is *effective*; touch the others and we're dead.'

fear:0.en: The basement archive was silent except for the hum of old machines. I searched row after row of cold drives. Then I found the file marked with Zero's symbol. A sharp *fear* cut through me — the date on the file was today. Someone had been here already.
fear:0.cnHint: 我在地下档案室找到了那个文件，心中升起一阵____。
fear:0.hook: The dust on the floor showed fresh footprints — leading deeper in.
fear:0.line: '*Fear* is useful,' Grey Crow said, 'it means you are still thinking.'

hit:0.en: Grey Crow tapped the monitor twice. The decryption program ran, failed, ran again. Then it *hit* the final layer of Zero's code and stopped cold. A single red character blinked on the screen. Ali leaned in close. None of us spoke for a long moment.
hit:0.cnHint: 解密程序终于____了零点代码的最后一层，却突然停住了。
hit:0.hook: The red character began to change — spelling out my name.
hit:0.line: 'It *hit* the wall. Whatever is behind that layer, Zero guards it hard.'

assume:0.en: 'Don't *assume* the door is safe,' Grey Crow said without turning around. I had one hand on the handle of the archive room exit. I froze. He pointed to a thin wire along the bottom edge — nearly invisible in the low blue light. My pulse spiked hard.
assume:0.cnHint: 灰鸦警告我，不要____那扇门是安全的。
assume:0.hook: Beyond the wire, something clicked softly in the dark.
assume:0.line: 'Never *assume* a quiet room is an empty one.'

generally:0.en: Ali pulled up Zero's pattern log on her screen. '*Generally*,' she said, tracing the spikes on the graph, 'Zero sends a pulse every forty seconds. But look here — last night the gap was four minutes.' That silence was the break we needed. Something had gone wrong for Zero too.
generally:0.cnHint: 阿里说，零点____每四十秒发送一次脉冲，但昨晚出现了异常沉默。
generally:0.hook: Four minutes of silence — and only one thing could cause that.
generally:0.line: '*Generally* he is precise, so that gap is the crack in his wall.'

interaction:0.en: Grey Crow pulled two signal feeds onto the same screen. 'Watch the *interaction*,' he said. Where the two waves crossed, a hidden pattern appeared — a map of Harbor City's underground tunnels. Zero had hidden the route inside the noise itself. Ali grabbed her recorder immediately.
interaction:0.cnHint: 两道信号的____揭示了隐藏在噪音中的地下隧道地图。
interaction:0.hook: One tunnel on the map led directly beneath the building we were in.
interaction:0.line: 'The *interaction* of the two signals — that is where Zero buried the truth.'

top:0.en: I climbed the filing shelf and brushed dust from the *top* of the highest cabinet. Taped there, flat and nearly invisible, was a thin card printed with a single frequency number. Grey Crow said nothing — he just wrote the number down and moved toward the door.
top:0.cnHint: 我在柜子____发现了一张贴着的卡片，上面印着一个神秘频率。
top:0.hook: Grey Crow dialed the frequency — and a voice answered before he finished.
top:0.line: 'Check the *top*; Zero always hides what matters just out of reach.'

seek:0.en: The archive room smelled of old circuits and dead air. I moved fast between the rows of black servers, looking for the file Grey Crow had marked. Someone else was *seeking* the same data — I could hear soft steps behind the locked door. I killed my light.
seek:0.cnHint: 我在档案室中____某份被标记的文件，却发现有人跟踪而来。
seek:0.hook: The steps stopped — then the door handle turned slowly.
seek:0.line: 'We are both *seeking* the same ghost file,' Grey Crow said quietly.

exist:0.en: Ali pulled up a city map on the cracked screen. 'Look,' she said. 'This district does not *exist* in any official record — no address, no power grid, no name.' The blank space on the map was three blocks wide. Something was there. Something the city had erased on purpose.
exist:0.cnHint: 地图上有一片区域被刻意抹去，仿佛根本不____。
exist:0.hook: Ali zoomed in — and the screen went black.
exist:0.line: 'Places that do not *exist* on maps are the most dangerous ones,' Ali warned.

supply:0.en: The cold storage unit under the market held more than food. Grey Crow cut the seal and we found stacked crates of signal jammers — enough to black out half the port. 'Someone built a private *supply* of these,' I said. The crates were stamped with tomorrow's date.
supply:0.cnHint: 我们在冷库中发现了一批神秘____，上面印着明天的日期。
supply:0.hook: Tomorrow was the night of the city-wide broadcast.
supply:0.line: 'A *supply* this size means they planned this for months,' Grey Crow said.

visit:0.en: Zero sent a message: one word, one time — 'coming.' An hour later I heard a knock at the safe-house door. Grey Crow checked the camera and stepped back. 'This *visit* is not friendly,' she said in a flat voice. The knock came again, harder, and the lights in the hall went out.
visit:0.cnHint: 零点突然宣布要来____，灰鸦的反应让气氛骤然紧张。
visit:0.hook: Behind the door, something slid across the floor toward us.
visit:0.line: 'A *visit* from Zero at midnight means we have already lost something,' Grey Crow said.

worry:0.en: Ali set up the relay node in twenty minutes flat. I watched the door. 'You are too quiet,' she said without looking up. 'That is my *worry* — when you go quiet you have already found bad news.' She was right. The signal I had just read named her as the next target.
worry:0.cnHint: 阿栗注意到我沉默不语，说出了她的____，而我已经看到了坏消息。
worry:0.hook: I folded the signal print and said nothing.
worry:0.line: 'My only *worry* right now is that you already know and will not tell me,' Ali said.

adapt:0.en: The city's code-wall updated every six hours. Most runners burned out trying to keep pace. Grey Crow had taught me to *adapt* — change your signal pattern before the wall does, not after. I rewrote my broadcast key in the dark, fingers moving by memory. The wall shifted. I was already gone.
adapt:0.cnHint: 面对不断更新的代码墙，我学会了____，抢在它变化之前就完成了转变。
adapt:0.hook: But Zero had been watching me learn.
adapt:0.line: 'You must *adapt* faster than the system or the system will own you,' Grey Crow told me.

bit:0.en: The intercepted file was almost empty — just a *bit* of raw code, six lines long, buried under layers of noise. But Ali stared at it for a long time. 'Six lines are enough,' she said softly. 'This is the key to the whole broadcast lock.' A small thing. A very dangerous small thing.
bit:0.cnHint: 截获的文件里只有____代码，阿栗却说这已经足够危险。
bit:0.hook: She started to type — then froze mid-key.
bit:0.line: 'A *bit* of the right code can bring down an entire network,' Ali said.

check:0.en: Grey Crow handed me a secondary ID chip before I entered the tower. 'Always *check* the signal stamp before you move to the next floor,' she said. 'If the stamp is wrong by one digit, walk out and do not look back.' I took the stairs. On the third floor the stamp was wrong by one digit.
check:0.cnHint: 灰鸦叮嘱我每层楼都要____信号戳，而我在三楼发现了异常。
check:0.hook: I looked back anyway — and saw Zero at the bottom of the stairs.
check:0.line: '*Check* it twice — in this tower, one wrong digit ends everything,' Grey Crow said.

consequence:0.en: The signal room smelled of burnt wire and cold coffee. Grey Crow spread the decoded files across the table. 'Every move Zero makes has a *consequence*,' he said quietly. I studied the chain of events on the screen — each action linked to a ruin, a silence, a missing person.
consequence:0.cnHint: 格雷·克劳展示了零点每个行动所带来的____，每一条线索都指向一次失踪。
consequence:0.hook: The last name on the list was mine.
consequence:0.line: 'Every move has a *consequence*, and Zero has made many moves.'

realize:0.en: Ali pulled up the transmission log on her screen. I read the timestamps twice before I began to *realize* what they meant — every blackout in Harbor City had been scheduled, not random. Someone had planned each moment of darkness with cold, quiet care.
realize:0.cnHint: 我盯着时间戳，慢慢____这座城市的每次断电都是被精心安排的。
realize:0.hook: Ali's hand froze above the keyboard.
realize:0.line: 'Do you *realize* how long this has been planned?'

mostly:0.en: The safe house was *mostly* dark — one pale light above the door, nothing else. Zero's crew moved through the city like that too, Grey Crow explained: quiet, low, staying out of bright places. I kept my back to the wall and listened to rain hammer the roof.
mostly:0.cnHint: 格雷·克劳说零点的人____在暗处行动，这个藏身处也不例外。
mostly:0.hook: Then the single light went out.
mostly:0.line: 'They are *mostly* shadows — you will not see them coming.'

exactly:0.en: Grey Crow placed a small chip on the table. 'This is *exactly* what Zero needs to break the city's voice grid,' he said. Not roughly. Not nearly. The chip fit the gap in the stolen decoder like a key made for one lock and no other.
exactly:0.cnHint: 格雷·克劳指出这枚芯片____是零点破解城市语音网络所需要的东西。
exactly:0.hook: The chip was already warm — someone had touched it recently.
exactly:0.line: 'This is *exactly* the piece Zero has been hunting for.'

vary:0.en: I studied Zero's coded messages across six months. The style, the timing, the cipher — everything seemed to *vary*, shifting just enough to stay ahead of any pattern scan. But one small habit never changed. Ali spotted it first: a single blank line before every command.
vary:0.cnHint: 零点的信息风格总在____，但阿里发现了一个从未改变的小习惯。
vary:0.hook: That habit was about to become Zero's greatest mistake.
vary:0.line: 'The codes *vary*, but the hand that writes them never does.'

brain:0.en: The room was silent except for the hum of old servers. 'Zero does not use a crew for thinking,' Grey Crow said, tapping his temple. 'Zero is the *brain* — every plan, every signal, every trap comes from one mind.' I felt the weight of that settle over the room.
brain:0.cnHint: 格雷·克劳解释说零点独自承担着整个组织的____，所有计划都出自一人。
brain:0.hook: One mind — and it was already thinking about us.
brain:0.line: 'Zero is the *brain*, and we have not yet seen it think.'

stress:0.en: Ali had not slept in thirty hours. I could see the *stress* in the line of her shoulders, the quick blink of her eyes. She kept rebuilding the same broken signal map, searching for the node that would unlock Zero's base frequency. The map kept failing. She kept going.
stress:0.cnHint: 阿里承受着巨大的____，连续三十小时没有休息，一遍遍重建那张信号地图。
stress:0.hook: Then the map returned a location — right beneath our feet.
stress:0.line: 'The *stress* is breaking us down before Zero even acts.'

financial:0.en: The document Grey Crow handed me was a *financial* record — accounts, transfers, sums moving through thirty fake names across Harbor City. Zero was not just a signal hacker. Zero was draining the city's hidden reserves, quietly, one coded transfer at a time.
financial:0.cnHint: 格雷·克劳交给我一份____记录，揭示零点正在悄悄抽空这座城市的隐秘储备。
financial:0.hook: The final transfer was dated for midnight tonight.
financial:0.line: 'This *financial* trail leads to the heart of the city's power.'

fruit:0.en: The safe behind the painting held no cash, no files — only a bowl of synthetic *fruit*, each piece hollowed out and packed with data chips. Grey Crow picked one up and turned it slowly. 'Someone hid an entire network in here,' he said. The lights cut out.
fruit:0.cnHint: 保险箱里藏着的不是文件，而是装满芯片的假____。
fruit:0.hook: In the dark, something else in the safe began to hum.
fruit:0.line: 'Every *fruit* in that bowl holds a stolen identity.'

waste:0.en: Ali spread the decoded files across the table. Forty years of underground research, all pointing to one name. 'Don't *waste* this lead,' Grey Crow said from the doorway, his coat still dripping rain. Zero had already burned three safe houses this week. We had maybe one hour left.
waste:0.cnHint: 灰鸦警告我们不要____这条来之不易的线索。
waste:0.hook: Then Ali's scanner beeped — Zero was already in the building.
waste:0.line: 'Don't *waste* my time — where is the second key?'

learning:0.en: The hidden classroom had not been used in years, but the walls were covered in coded script. Grey Crow ran his fingers along the lines. 'This is not graffiti,' he said quietly. 'This is *learning* — someone was being trained here, taught how to break the city's core signal.' Dust fell from the ceiling.
learning:0.cnHint: 废弃教室的墙上布满密码，那是某种秘密____的痕迹。
learning:0.hook: The last line on the wall ended with my own call sign.
learning:0.line: '*Learning* the code is one thing — surviving it is another.'

manager:0.en: The hotel lobby was empty except for one man behind the desk. Grey Crow slid a photo across the counter. The *manager* glanced at it, then at us, then slowly reached below the desk. Ali stepped forward. The man's hand came back up holding a thin silver key on a black cord.
manager:0.cnHint: 酒店____看了一眼照片，默默拿出了一把钥匙。
manager:0.hook: The room number on the key tag had been scratched off.
manager:0.line: 'The *manager* of this floor has not been seen since Tuesday night.'

knowledge:0.en: Grey Crow locked the door and turned to face us. 'The signal we intercepted — it carries *knowledge* that the city council has buried for thirty years,' he said. Ali pulled up the decryption log. The data was still streaming in, line after line, filling the screen like a slow flood of cold light.
knowledge:0.cnHint: 那段截获的信号里藏着被封锁三十年的____。
knowledge:0.hook: The last file in the stream was addressed directly to me.
knowledge:0.line: '*Knowledge* like this gets people killed — are you sure you want it?'

mental:0.en: The test lab on floor nine was full of old headsets and blank monitors. 'They were running *mental* scans on the workers here,' Ali said, pulling a cracked headset from the shelf. Grey Crow said nothing. On the floor, a row of numbered chairs faced a single dark screen. All the chairs were bolted down.
mental:0.cnHint: 九楼实验室曾被用来对工人进行____扫描。
mental:0.hook: One headset still had a charge light blinking green.
mental:0.line: 'The *mental* scans were not for treatment — they were for mapping.'

weight:0.en: Ali passed me the drive without a word. The moment it landed in my palm I felt the *weight* of it — not just the grams of plastic and metal, but everything stored inside: names, routes, the whole hidden map of Harbor City's black network. Grey Crow watched my face. 'Now you understand,' he said.
weight:0.cnHint: 那个小小的驱动器压在手心，我感受到了它沉甸甸的____。
weight:0.hook: Grey Crow's next words told me I could never hand it over.
weight:0.line: 'The *weight* of what you carry now — that never goes away.'

academic:0.en: The university archive room smelled of old paper and cold air. Grey Crow pointed to a shelf of bound reports. 'These look like *academic* work,' he said, 'but read the margins.' I pulled one open. Every margin was filled with tiny handwritten code, layer upon layer, going all the way to the last page.
academic:0.cnHint: 那些看似____论文的报告，页边全都写满了隐藏的密码。
academic:0.hook: The final margin note read: 'If you find this, run.'
academic:0.line: 'This *academic* cover fooled the city scanners for twenty years.'

trouble:0.en: The signal room smelled of old wires and cold coffee. Grey Crow spread six files across the table and tapped the top one. 'Every name here is in *trouble*,' he said. 'Someone is erasing them from the city grid, one by one.' I counted the names. Mine was fifth.
trouble:0.cnHint: 灰鸦在信号室里展示了一批危险档案，我发现自己的名字也在其中，陷入了____。
trouble:0.hook: The sixth name had already been erased.
trouble:0.line: 'Everyone on this list is in *trouble*, and you are on this list.'

reflect:0.en: Ali pulled the small mirror from her coat and held it near the cracked screen. The hidden code only appeared when the light hit a certain angle. 'Surfaces *reflect* more than light,' she said quietly. 'They reflect what people try to hide.' The code spelled a single name: Zero.
reflect:0.cnHint: 阿栗用镜子让隐藏代码现形，屏幕上____出了一个令人震惊的名字。
reflect:0.hook: That name was supposed to be dead.
reflect:0.line: 'Surfaces *reflect* more than light — they reveal what is hidden.'

attend:0.en: The briefing started at midnight. I had no invitation, but Grey Crow left a door open on the third floor. I slipped in and stood at the back. Of the twelve people who *attended*, three were already working for Zero. I just did not know which three.
attend:0.cnHint: 我偷偷____了一场深夜简报会，意识到房间里有零点的内线。
attend:0.hook: One of them looked straight at me and smiled.
attend:0.line: 'Not everyone who *attends* this meeting will leave as a friend.'

belief:0.en: Ali set the decoder on the table between us. 'This whole operation rests on one *belief*,' she said, her voice low and steady: 'that Zero cannot intercept a signal he does not know exists.' She pressed the start button. For three seconds, nothing moved. Then every light in the room went out.
belief:0.cnHint: 阿栗解释了行动的核心____，但房间突然陷入黑暗。
belief:0.hook: Someone had been listening the entire time.
belief:0.line: 'Our only advantage is the *belief* that Zero does not know we are here.'

carry:0.en: The package was small enough to fit in a coat pocket, but Grey Crow treated it like glass. 'Do not let it touch a network, not even for a second,' he said. I was chosen to *carry* it across the checkpoint alone, with no backup and no cover story ready.
carry:0.cnHint: 我被指派独自____一个极其敏感的包裹通过检查站。
carry:0.hook: The checkpoint guard already had his hand out.
carry:0.line: 'You will *carry* it alone — any partner makes you a target.'

else:0.en: I ran every check I knew: signal trace, code match, source log. All clean. Ali leaned over my shoulder and said nothing for a long moment. Then: 'Look at it differently. Someone *else* built this trap — not Zero.' That single word changed everything I thought I understood about tonight.
else:0.cnHint: 阿栗的一句话让我意识到，设下这个陷阱的是____某个人，而不是零点。
else:0.hook: If not Zero, then the danger was much closer.
else:0.line: 'Someone *else* set this trap, and that person is in this building.'

major:0.en: The server room hummed beneath City Hall. Grey Crow spread three data chips across the cold floor. 'One of these holds a *major* secret,' he said quietly. 'Big enough to bring down the whole city council.' I stared at the chips. They all looked the same.
major:0.cnHint: 灰鸦在服务器室发现了一个可能颠覆市议会的____秘密。
major:0.hook: Only one chip was real — but which one?
major:0.line: 'This is a *major* find — do not touch it yet.'

communication:0.en: Ali crouched by the broken radio tower inside the old signal station. Every channel was dead. 'Someone cut all *communication* between the north and south districts,' she said, her voice tight. Outside, the rain hammered the windows. We were completely alone — and someone knew it.
communication:0.cnHint: 阿栗发现南北两区之间的____被切断，我们陷入孤立。
communication:0.hook: A shadow moved past the frosted glass door.
communication:0.line: 'All *communication* is gone — we are on our own now.'

market:0.en: The underground data *market* ran out of a basement beneath a noodle shop. Sellers lined the walls, each with a glowing screen. Grey Crow leaned close. 'Whatever Zero is planning, the parts were bought here.' I scanned every face. One of them had already seen us.
market:0.cnHint: 我们潜入地下数据____，寻找零点行动计划的线索。
market:0.hook: A hand reached for the light switch in the dark.
market:0.line: 'Every secret in this city passes through this *market*.'

apply:0.en: Ali held a thin strip of code paper against the locked door panel. 'You have to *apply* it slowly,' she whispered, 'or the sensor reads it as an attack.' My hands were shaking. The strip warmed and the lock clicked. Behind that door was Zero's private terminal.
apply:0.cnHint: 阿栗教我如何____解码纸条来打开零点的私人终端门锁。
apply:0.hook: The terminal screen flickered on — and it was already watching us.
apply:0.line: '*Apply* the strip gently — one wrong move and the alarm fires.'

per:0.en: The data burst arrived in pieces — one fragment *per* second, each one scrambled. Grey Crow sat rigid, counting under his breath. If a single fragment arrived late, the whole message would collapse. Twelve fragments. Eleven. Ten. Then the feed cut out. We had nine pieces and a missing ending.
per:0.cnHint: 加密信息每____秒传送一段，但传输在关键时刻中断了。
per:0.hook: The missing fragment held the name we needed most.
per:0.line: 'One fragment *per* second — stay still and do not breathe.'

treat:0.en: Zero's note was short: three lines, no name. The last line read — 'I will *treat* your silence as agreement.' Grey Crow folded the paper without a word. The offer was clear: say nothing, walk away, live quietly. But walking away meant the whole city paid the cost instead.
treat:0.cnHint: 零点留下纸条，声称会把我们的沉默____为默许。
treat:0.hook: Grey Crow's jaw tightened — he had already made his choice.
treat:0.line: 'He will *treat* our silence as a yes — we cannot stay quiet.'

creative:0.en: The coded graffiti on the archive wall was unlike anything I had seen. Ali traced the shapes with one finger. 'Whoever wrote this is *creative*,' she said softly, almost with respect. 'Standard cipher tools will not crack it.' That meant the message was meant for one person only — and that person was not us.
creative:0.cnHint: 档案馆墙上的密码涂鸦极具____，让普通破译工具毫无用武之地。
creative:0.hook: Ali's finger stopped — one symbol did not belong.
creative:0.line: 'This is *creative* work — whoever made it knew we would come.'

perform:0.en: Grey Crow handed me a small device. 'You need to *perform* the handshake sequence before the building's system reboots,' he said. 'You have forty seconds.' I had never done it alone. The screen counted down. My fingers moved. At second thirty-eight the system accepted the code — then went dark.
perform:0.cnHint: 我必须独自在倒计时结束前____握手程序，否则系统将重启并抹除证据。
perform:0.hook: The sudden darkness meant either success — or something far worse.
perform:0.line: '*Perform* the sequence now — do not wait for my signal.'

prepare:0.en: The signal came at midnight. Grey Crow slid a data chip across the table. 'You have one hour,' he said. I began to *prepare* my kit: scanner, mask, false ID. Ali watched the door. Outside, Zero's men were already moving through the wet streets.
prepare:0.cnHint: 午夜信号到来，我开始____行动装备，时间只剩一小时。
prepare:0.hook: The scanner blinked once, then went dark.
prepare:0.line: '*Prepare* fast — Zero does not wait for anyone.'

workplace:0.en: Grey Crow's map led me to a sealed floor above the old port. This was Zero's *workplace*: rows of silent terminals, cables thick as rope, and the smell of burnt circuits. No guards. That alone made my skin cold. Ali sent one word over the link: 'Trap.'
workplace:0.cnHint: 我找到了零点的____，空无一人的景象让人不安。
workplace:0.hook: Every terminal screen lit up at the exact same second.
workplace:0.line: 'This *workplace* was built to be found — and then to kill.'

post:0.en: Ali found the message board first. Someone had used a coded spray to *post* a warning on the inner wall: three broken circles and a number. Grey Crow said the number matched a dead agent's file. My fingers tightened around the scanner. The circles were still wet.
post:0.cnHint: 阿栗在墙上发现有人____了一条暗语警告，墨迹未干。
post:0.hook: The dead agent's file had my photo inside it.
post:0.line: 'Who would *post* a warning here and then just vanish?'

complete:0.en: I needed the full signal map to move forward. Grey Crow told me the archive held only broken pieces. 'You must *complete* it yourself,' he said, handing me a second chip. Ali's voice cut in over static: 'Zero already knows you are looking. He let you start.'
complete:0.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉我必须____那份残缺的信号地图。
complete:0.hook: The second chip was warm — as if someone had just held it.
complete:0.line: '*Complete* the map before the next rain cycle — or we lose everything.'

measure:0.en: The room had no windows. I used the scanner to *measure* the signal pulse coming from the floor — steady, deep, and far too strong for normal city noise. Grey Crow crouched beside me. 'That is not a broadcast,' he said quietly. 'That is a countdown.'
measure:0.cnHint: 我用扫描仪____地板下的信号强度，结果令人震惊。
measure:0.hook: The pulse quickened the moment I touched the wall.
measure:0.line: '*Measure* it again — I need to know how much time is left.'

recommend:0.en: I asked Grey Crow which route to take through the server maze. He did not hesitate. 'I *recommend* the east corridor — but know that Zero built it.' Ali sent a small laugh over the link. Nothing Zero built was safe. I took the east corridor anyway.
recommend:0.cnHint: 灰鸦____了一条路线，但那条路是零点亲手建造的。
recommend:0.hook: The east corridor door sealed shut behind me.
recommend:0.line: 'I *recommend* you trust no door that opens too easily.'

resource:0.en: Zero had cut our access. No city grid, no backup link, no safe channel. Every *resource* we had was now inside this single room. Grey Crow spread the chips on the table like cards. Ali said nothing. The rain hammered the roof, and the lights dimmed once.
resource:0.cnHint: 零点切断了我们的所有外部支持，这个房间里的东西是我们仅有的____。
resource:0.hook: One chip on the table began to smoke.
resource:0.line: 'One *resource* remains — and it might already be compromised.'

specific:0.en: The archive held thousands of signal logs. I asked Grey Crow what I was looking for. He leaned close and gave me one *specific* file name — seven characters, no spaces. 'Do not open anything else,' he said. Ali's breathing stopped on the link. Then: 'It is already open.'
specific:0.cnHint: 灰鸦给了我一个____的文件名，但那个文件已经被人打开了。
specific:0.hook: The file name on screen matched my own agent code.
specific:0.line: 'Be *specific* — one wrong file and Zero hears everything.'

policy:1.en: Rain hammered the steel bridge. Grey Crow pressed a chip into my palm. 'The city council changed the *policy* last night,' he said. 'No signal can cross Zone Four without a scan.' Every encrypted message Ali and I had sent was now exposed. The bridge lights flickered once, then died.
policy:1.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉我，市议会昨晚更改了____，我们的加密信号全部暴露了。
policy:1.hook: Somewhere in the dark, a scanner hummed to life.
policy:1.line: 'The new *policy* means every signal we sent is now readable.'

industry:1.en: The old port district never slept. Cranes, smoke, and the low groan of machines filled the wet air. Grey Crow called this stretch the *industry* belt — every warehouse here belonged to Zero's network. Ali tugged my sleeve and pointed at a crate stamped with a signal logo I had seen in the encrypted files.
industry:1.cnHint: 灰鸦将港口一带称为____地带，这里的每座仓库都属于零点的网络。
industry:1.hook: The crate was moving, and no worker was near it.
industry:1.line: 'In this *industry* belt, even the air has ears.'

concern:1.en: Ali met me under the broken overpass. Her face was tight. 'My *concern* is not the rain or the patrol drones,' she said, scanning the empty street. 'It is that Zero already knows we are here.' She held up her wrist scanner. The screen showed two signals — ours, and one other, closing fast.
concern:1.cnHint: 阿栗表示她真正的____不是雨或无人机，而是零点已经知道我们在这里。
concern:1.hook: The second signal stopped — right outside our hiding spot.
concern:1.line: 'My real *concern* is that we have been tracked from the start.'

present:1.en: The neon market was loud and crowded, a perfect place to hide. Grey Crow was not *present* — he had gone dark two hours ago. Ali bought a paper cup of tea and passed it to me without a word. Somewhere in the noise, a voice said my code name, clear as a bell.
present:1.cnHint: 灰鸦不在____场，阿栗递给我一杯茶，人群中却突然有人喊出了我的代号。
present:1.hook: I did not know that voice, but it knew me well.
present:1.line: 'Grey Crow is not *present*, so you answer to me now.'

claim:1.en: A stranger in a grey coat stepped from a doorway. He held up a cracked data card. 'I *claim* this card gives me full rights to the East Tower transmitter,' he said, his eyes never blinking. Ali shook her head slowly behind him. The data card's serial number matched one reported stolen from my own file.
claim:1.cnHint: 一个陌生人____这张卡赋予他东塔发射机的完整权限，而卡的序列号竟与我档案中失窃的记录吻合。
claim:1.hook: He smiled, and I realised he had been waiting for me.
claim:1.line: 'I *claim* this tower, this signal, and everything in it.'

half:1.en: The checkpoint light turned red. The guard checked my pass for what felt like an hour, then handed back only *half* of it — the part with my real name was gone. I looked at Ali across the barrier. She mouthed one word: Zero. The crowd behind me pushed forward, and the gate slammed shut.
half:1.cnHint: 检查站的警卫只还给我____通行证，另一半——写有我真实姓名的那部分——不见了。
half:1.hook: Without that half, I no longer existed in the city's records.
half:1.line: 'They kept the other *half* — the half that proves who you are.'

successful:1.en: Grey Crow lit a cigarette outside the relay station. 'Every *successful* break-in Zero has done began on this street,' he said, pointing to the drain at the corner. I crouched and looked. A thin wire ran from the drain into the station wall — live, still warm. Zero had already been here tonight.
successful:1.cnHint: 灰鸦说零点每一次____的入侵都从这条街开始，而那根细线证明他今晚已经来过了。
successful:1.hook: The wire was still warm — Zero had left only minutes ago.
successful:1.line: 'Not one *successful* move of his started anywhere else.'

access:1.en: The side door had no handle, only a code pad slick with rain. Ali hacked it in thirty seconds flat. 'I have *access*,' she said quietly, stepping inside. The corridor beyond was empty, but every wall screen was on, every camera turning toward us at the same moment, as if something had been expecting two visitors.
access:1.cnHint: 阿栗在三十秒内破解了密码，获得了进入权限，但走廊里的所有摄像头同时转向了我们。
access:1.hook: Every camera turned at once — nothing does that by accident.
access:1.line: 'I have *access*, but something in here already knows it.'

positive:1.en: The rain hammered the stone steps outside Central Gate. Grey Crow pressed a small device into my hand. 'The signal is clean,' he said. His voice was flat, but his eyes carried something *positive*—a steady belief that we could still fix what Zero had broken in this city.
positive:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在中央门外向我传递装置，眼神中透着一种____的力量。
positive:1.hook: But the device flickered once, then went dark.
positive:1.line: 'Stay *positive*—doubt is the first door Zero opens.'

economic:1.en: Neon signs buzzed above the flooded market street. I pulled up the city grid on my lens. Every *economic* line in Harbor City ran through one encrypted node—food, power, trade. Zero had found that node. If it fell, the whole city would starve before dawn.
economic:1.cnHint: 我在市场街发现，港城所有____命脉都汇聚在一个加密节点。
economic:1.hook: The node's signal just moved—closer to us.
economic:1.line: 'Every *economic* line in this city feeds that one point.'

link:1.en: Ali crouched beside a broken street lamp, her fingers tracing wet graffiti on the wall. 'There,' she whispered. A single painted ring—the *link* between Zero's two cells. Find who drew it, and the whole chain breaks. Around us, rain erased footprints fast.
link:1.cnHint: 阿里在街灯旁的涂鸦中发现了两个犯罪团伙之间的关键____。
link:1.hook: The paint was still wet—someone had been here seconds ago.
link:1.line: 'This ring is the *link*—break it and Zero falls apart.'

produce:1.en: I watched the old print shop on Deck Nine from across the slick street. Every night it claimed to *produce* paper maps for tourists. But the lights inside burned until three in the morning. No tourist shop works those hours. Something else was being made in there.
produce:1.cnHint: 第九层甲板上的印刷店声称____旅游地图，但我注意到它的灯光整夜不灭。
produce:1.hook: Then a shadow crossed the window—too tall to be the owner.
produce:1.line: 'They don't *produce* maps in there—they print orders for Zero.'

teach:1.en: Grey Crow stopped at the mouth of Copper Alley and pointed to the coded signs above each door. 'Let me *teach* you how Zero marks safe houses,' he said quietly. Each symbol looked like a simple weather mark to most people. To us, they were a map of danger.
teach:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在铜巷口停下，要____我辨认零的安全屋暗号。
teach:1.hook: The third door bore no mark at all—that was the real warning.
teach:1.line: 'I will *teach* you this once—after that, you read them alone.'

worth:1.en: Ali held up a small data chip she had pulled from a drain beside the night market. 'Is it *worth* anything?' I asked. She turned it slowly under a neon light. The chip was scratched and wet, but the code stamped on its edge made my breath stop cold.
worth:1.cnHint: 阿里在夜市旁的排水沟里捡到一枚芯片，我们判断它是否____冒险一查。
worth:1.hook: That code matched the one Grey Crow told us to fear most.
worth:1.line: 'Trust me—this chip is *worth* every risk we just took.'

common:1.en: Zero left no grand signs. That was the *common* truth every investigator in Harbor City learned too late—his marks were plain, small, and easy to miss. A chalk dot. A bent antenna. I stood at the crossroads and finally saw them everywhere around me.
common:1.cnHint: 在港城十字路口，我终于明白零的行事方式有一个____规律。
common:1.hook: Every mark pointed toward the building directly behind me.
common:1.line: 'It is a *common* trick—hide the biggest secret in plain sight.'

daily:1.en: The old woman at the corner stall sold hot broth every morning without fail. Grey Crow said her *daily* route was the one fixed point Zero never touched. So we used it—met beside her cart at six, passed notes through the steam, then split before sunrise hit the water.
daily:1.cnHint: 那位老妇人____出摊的路线，成了我们在零的眼皮下传递情报的掩护。
daily:1.hook: This morning her cart was gone—and so was Grey Crow.
daily:1.line: 'Her *daily* route is the one thread Zero cannot cut—yet.'

determine:1.en: Rain hammered the cracked street outside Gate Nine. Grey Crow crouched beside a smashed signal box, tracing burnt wires with one finger. 'We need to *determine* whether Zero cut this line before or after the blackout,' he said. Ali checked her watch. Forty seconds of silence followed.
determine:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在破损的信号箱旁，试图____断电线被切断的时间。
